title: The High-Resolution Cross-Dispersed Echelle White Pupil Spectrometer of the McDonald Observatory 2.7-m Telescope
what_was_studied: White-pupil cross-dispersed echelle design and observing configurations
numerical_result: The 2dcoude design emphasizes a resolving-power mode near 60000 and an optical limit near 120000; the applicable value depends on the observing configuration
remaining_question: Which mode and detector era applies to each archival data set?

title: Calibrating iodine cells for precise radial velocities
what_was_studied: Use of Tull TS12 spectra to validate Fourier-transform iodine scans
numerical_result: TS12 spectra at resolving power above 200000 reproduced the relevant iodine structure well enough to diagnose the HET cell discrepancy
remaining_question: Can routine echelle checks detect cell-temperature errors before an RV re-reduction?

title: Robert G. Tull Coude Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Current facility description of four spectrograph configurations
numerical_result: McDonald describes TS11, TS12, TS21 and TS23 at the 2.7 m Coude focus and calls them the observatory's highest-resolution capability
remaining_question: The undated page is not a dated availability or calibration-stability statement
